phase: Phase 15: Basecamp Stationary Repeater UI & Dedicated Low-Power Cockpit Mode

stories.title: Basecamp Repeater State Management & Platform Bridge Wiring
stories.description: Implement RepeaterUiState.kt and RepeaterViewModel.kt in app/sharedUI, wiring MeshRepeaterService into Koin DI and IntercomHardwareBridge/AndroidPlatformBridge/IntercomBridge. Manage stationary node state: battery percentage, solar charging indicator, active neighbor count, forwarded packet counters, and remote diagnostic ping triggers.
acceptanceCriteria: Exposes reactive StateFlow<RepeaterUiState> with active neighbor table, forwarded packet count, and beacon rate
Toggles MeshRepeaterService active state, releasing microphone/speaker pipelines during repeater mode
Supports remote diagnostic ping triggering with round-trip latency reflection
100% test pass on JVM and platform compilation

stories.title: Compose Multiplatform Basecamp Repeater Screen & OLED Dark Standby
stories.description: Implement dedicated Compose Multiplatform BasecampRepeaterScreen.kt in app/sharedUI: high-contrast OLED black theme for low power consumption, live solar/battery telemetry gauges, animated RF relay wave, active neighbor radar list, and full-screen low-brightness night standby lock.
acceptanceCriteria: Zero-allocation rendering loop in standby with OLED power-saving pure black background (#000000)
Live telemetry displays: battery percentage, solar status, forwarded packets, and heard rider callsigns
Registered in Navigation 3 AppNavGraph under polymorphic NavKey routing (Gotcha 1)
Full build passes without lint or compilation errors

stories.title: Native iOS SwiftUI Basecamp Repeater Cockpit & StandBy Display
stories.description: Implement 100% native SwiftUI BasecampRepeaterView.swift in app/iosApp (Rule 1): pure native SwiftUI layout, low-power display brightness reduction, Live Activity / StandBy mode banner, and seamless CancellationHandle bridge subscription.
acceptanceCriteria: 100% native SwiftUI with zero Compose Multiplatform imports (Rule 1)
Subscribes cleanly to IntercomBridge.kt repeater state with CancellationHandle lifecycle
Supports iOS 17+ StandBy landscape cockpit display for stationary phone placement in basecamp/tent
Compiles cleanly without Swift or KMP linking errors

stories.title: Remote Repeater Telemetry & Diagnostic Ping Cockpit HUD Integration
stories.description: Integrate remote basecamp repeater health status into the main cockpit HUD (HomeScreen.kt and ContentView.swift): top avionics bar repeater beacon badge (showing nearest basecamp distance, battery %, and link quality), and 1-tap diagnostic ping triggering.
acceptanceCriteria: Cockpit HUD displays basecamp beacon status badge when a repeater is heard within 3 hops
Diagnostic ping trigger measures round-trip latency and displays reflection time on HUD
Maintains zero-scroll tactical cockpit layout constraint on mobile handlebars
Full automated multiplatform verification gates pass cleanly
